stem: How did the idea for HARP come about?

options.label: F
options.text: A veteran thought of a practical use for a historic airfield.

options.label: G
options.text: The National Park Service wanted to open an airfield to the public.

options.label: H
options.text: Citizens of New York City wanted to honor their airfield's military past.

options.label: J
options.text: Pilots who flew during World War II needed a place to restore old planes.
